intake.description: This is about the application export app.round22_access_export for case_id1, viewed in the Subscription Billing context. It is not about an amount on a report card. Two of us ran the same export query and got different results. orderops_investigator sees a quantity of 10 with one visible row. dia-investigator-round19 sees a quantity of 25 with two visible rows. Neither account has had any role changes. Why do the sign-ins show different results for the same export?

On the Application Movements page of Application Load Support, the Movement Units card shows 7661 with no filters applied. Can you explain how this figure is calculated, and confirm whether it agrees with the stock movements held in the application? For reference, the application has 360 seeded movement rows.

In the Movement Units visual, application movement1 currently shows 16 units. I need to know how many units this movement had as of 2026-10-20 at 12:00 UTC. I didn't save an export from that time, so I have nothing to compare against. Can you tell me what the value was at that point, and how the report works out a past value like this?

With no filters applied, the Invoiced Amount card on the Subscription Billing page shows 950. When I export invoices from the billing application and add them up, I get 250 + 100 + 250 + 100 = 700. Where does the extra 250 on the card come from?

With nothing selected on the page (no slicers or filters applied), the MRR All Plans card on the Subscription Billing page shows 600. Could you explain how this figure is technically calculated and which subscriptions are counted in it? I'm asking about the calculation logic and what's included, not for a decision on business policy.

In the job history, the most recent run of round_two_application_load_audited_20261003 shows a status of Failed. I'm looking at the Movement Units visual on the Application Movements page of Application Load Support. Can you tell me what happened with that run and whether this report is affected?

I'm looking at the Invoiced Amount visual on the Subscription Billing page. When I checked the job history, the Billing Warehouse transformations show as Failed on the most recent run. Can you tell me what happened, and whether the Invoiced Amount I'm seeing is current?

On the Inventory Health page, the Movement Units visual shows Handled Quantity as 8765 for the whole model, with no report filters or restrictions applied. I added up the units on all 360 original movement records in the ordersops source myself and got 7661. Why are these two totals different? Which figure should I use?

Movement movement900701 is in the ordersops application export with 17 units, but it doesn't show up in the Movement Units visual on the Application Movements page. I also checked the landing export and it has no row for this movement either. Can you tell me why this record isn't in the report?
The Collected Amount card on the Subscription Billing page shows 550. I'm not reporting an error. I'd like to know which payment rows make up this total and how the card adds them up to get 550.

I'm looking for movement900099 from around 2026-09-12. I expected to see it, but it doesn't appear in the Movement Units visual on the Application Movements page. I also checked the application export, and it isn't there either. I'm not reporting an amount for this movement. I just can't find the record anywhere.

Movement movement6 (product product_id7) shows up more than once in the export from the Movement Units visual, and it also appears more than once in the loaded Gold movement_values table. In the original movement export from the source system it appears only once. Where are the extra copies coming from?

I've attached a screenshot of the Movement records table on the Application Movements page in Application Load Support. It shows a single row: warehouse_id 1, product_id 4, units 17. The table doesn't show the application movement ID, and I don't know it. Could you work out which movement this row actually is, then trace it from the report back to ordersops and explain how it ends up showing 17 units? I'm not saying a record is missing or duplicated. I just want to see where this number comes from.

I've attached a screenshot of the Movement records table on the Application Movements page in Application Load Support. It shows one row: warehouse_id 1, product_id 2, units 21. The application movement ID isn't shown in the table and I don't know what it is. Could you find the movement record behind this row and trace it back to the ordersops source system? I'd like to see where the 21 units come from. I'm not saying a record is missing or duplicated. I just want to understand how this row and its units value are built.

I've attached a screenshot of the Movement records table on the Application Movements page in Application Load Support. It shows one row: warehouse_id 2, product_id 3, units 3. The table doesn't show the application movement ID, and I don't know what it is. Could you find the actual movement key for this row and trace it from the report back to ordersops? I'd like to know how the 3 units shown here were carried through. I'm not saying a record is missing or duplicated. I just want to understand where this value comes from.

I've attached a screenshot of the Movement records table on the Application Movements page in Application Load Support. It shows one row: warehouse_id 3, product_id 2, units 20. The movement ID doesn't appear in the table and I don't know what it is. Could you find out which movement this row actually is, then follow it back to the ordersops source system and show me where its 20 units come from? I'm not saying a record is missing or duplicated. I just want to understand where this row comes from.

I pulled two application stock-movement exports during the current test window, and they don't agree on movement900201. The earlier export shows 41 units for this record. The later export shows 47 units for the same record. The record has a September business date, so I didn't expect its value to move. Why did this historical record change between the two exports, and which value should Movement Units show?

On the Application Movements page, the Movement Units card shows 7661. I have no slicers or selections applied. When I total movement units in the ordersops application and in its landing table, both come to 7692. Why is the card showing a lower number than the source?

The Movement Units visual isn't showing fresh data. In the job history, the latest run of round_two_application_load_audited_20261003 still shows as running. Can you tell me what that run's status is right now? I'm not sure, but could something like a lock be holding it up?

On the Application Movements page, the Movement Units visual shows 2948 when I filter to warehouse_id 1. I pulled an export from ordersops filtered to warehouse_id 2, and it totals 2084. Everything else about the scope is the same in both. Can you help me understand why these two numbers are different?
